title: Orbit and Horizon
author: Casper Eriksen
blurb: Felix Zhou, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
